review_kind: Software source review by an OpenAI assistant agent

bounded_replay.producer_order_review: The command order satisfies the inspected producer and receipt dependencies. All 19 retained output paths were present at review. The harness deletes these outputs in its fresh repository-shaped copy before rerunning the listed commands and compares their canonical JSON identities afterward.
bounded_replay.closure_qualification: Counts derive from the inspected command definitions and producers. Collection of the final top-level manifest and execution of the complete bounded replay remain separate parent gates. This review did not execute the 16-command suite.

gzip_handling.source_archives_and_completed_native_evi: Exact compressed input bytes remain authenticated. Regeneration does not replace those pinned containers.
gzip_handling.separate_word_reconstruction: Both new word payloads are compared after decoding and canonical JSON serialization. Each newly generated container hash must match its own constructor receipt. Only those checked container-hash fields are substituted with the retained values before exact comparison of every remaining constructor proof field.
gzip_handling.separate_geometry_reconstruction: The regenerated SEVEN57-GEOMETRY.json.gz payload and SEVEN57-RESULT.json are compared canonically against retained artifacts in a separate fresh directory.
gzip_handling.scope: Compression metadata or deflate differences are not treated as mathematical differences. No proof-relevant payload field is dropped. Exact hashes remain in force for immutable source archives and completed native evidence.

collector.assertion_mode: An explicit RuntimeError rejects optimized Python execution before input collection or output creation; the prior assert __debug__ guard was corrected.
collector.fresh_native_mode: Both fresh-native-base and fresh-native-extra stages must occur and every reported top-level stage must succeed. A partial fresh pair is rejected, a simultaneous reuse receipt is rejected, both native RESULT files are mandatory, and both complete fresh native trees are retained.
collector.reuse_native_mode: When neither fresh-native stage occurs, REUSED-NATIVE-AUTH.json with PASS_EXACT_SHIPPED_NATIVE_REUSE is mandatory and retained. The completed evidence is identified as authenticated reuse rather than a fresh native execution in that run.
authoritative_bindings: The retained executed runner hash equals the completed run's runner_sha256.
Top-level run, complete admission and original release statuses must all be the required PASS statuses.
The admission result and original release receipt bytes match the hashes in the completed run result.
DEPENDENCIES.json, ACTUAL-NATIVE-SOURCES.json, NATIVE-RECEIPT.json and inputs/source/MANIFEST.json match their authoritative completed-run hashes.
The actual admission/package/MANIFEST.json hash equals both admission.package_manifest_sha256 and release.manifest_sha256.
Both separately retained STAGES.json files exactly equal their corresponding authoritative result stages.
The complete indexed inputs/source and admission/package digest projections, excluding their own MANIFEST.json and bytecode, equal the respective authoritative manifests.
The exact new root interval, conditional kappa and complete global profile agree with the independently checked physical invoice.
All mandatory concise receipts must be retained, and copied evidence bytes are checked against the complete run inventory.
collector.failure_behavior: Failed statuses, missing required receipts, inconsistent modes, hash mismatches, stage mismatches or source projection mismatches stop collection before a new complete conditional claim is written. A failed late collection may leave a partial evidence directory; its presence is not a completed claim.

independent_outer_copy.same_scientific_target: The retained independent outer copy and the inspected final admission package share the actual B input, productive profile, certified complex endpoint and derived new kappa.
independent_outer_copy.different_comparison_metadata: Their SPEC.json and CLAIM.json carry different comparison baselines and discovered diagnostics. Corresponding ledger comparison-margin and source-hash fields therefore differ.
independent_outer_copy.required_interpretation: Do not require the two outer copies to be byte-identical. The bounded command replays the separately retained independent arithmetic copy; the original complete outer release is independently retained and authenticated.

post_run_guard_review.allowed_change: The sole indented assert __debug__ line may become if not __debug__: raise RuntimeError('Python assertions must be enabled').
post_run_guard_review.checks: Exact one-site byte replacement, identical remaining AST, unchanged guard position immediately before verify_source(), compilation in both optimization modes, and explicit hardened -O rejection before creating a fresh work directory.
post_run_guard_review.attribution: The original completed nonoptimized release remains attributed to its actual executed source. A guard-equivalence receipt does not claim that the hardened successor repeated the release.
post_run_guard_review.execution_qualification: This source review is not the post-run guard receipt. That separate command must be run by the parent after preserving the actual executed runner and applying the sole guard change.

scope.qualification: Agent software source review and bounded read-only receipt/path inspection. No native all-column, whole-owner, full ordinary/outer, or complete bounded replay is claimed by this artifact. The inherited theorem premises and the separate parent release gates remain.
